youtube.title: 🕵️ This AI Pentester Hacks Your App Before Hackers Do
youtube.description: You can now hack your own app before real hackers do. Shannon is an open-source AI pentester with 49K stars on GitHub. It reads your source code, maps every possible attack path, then drives a real browser and fires actual exploits. No exploit, no report, every finding comes with working proof. Launch it with one npx command, and yes, you can say: Hey Claude, run Shannon. Comment the word 'hack' and I'll send you the link and tutorial for this repo.

linkedin.text:
🕵️ What if you could hack your own app before real hackers do?

Most security audits give you a list of theoretical risks and a long PDF you never finish reading.

Shannon is an open-source AI pentester that skips the guesswork entirely:

✅ Combines source-code analysis with live exploitation
✅ Identifies attack paths across your web app and APIs
✅ Uses browser automation and command-line tools to run real exploits
✅ Follows one rule: "No exploit, no report" — only working proof-of-concept findings make the cut
✅ Launches with a single command, and yes: "Hey Claude, run Shannon."

49,671 GitHub stars. AGPL-3.0 licensed. Install with: npx @keygraph/shannon@latest

Only run it against apps and environments you own or have explicit written authorization to test.

Would you trust an AI agent to pentest your own code? 👇
